statistics.intro_staff.text: Events held, sign-ups, confirmed attendance, and the attendance rate of every team and player.

statistics.intro_coach.text: Events held, sign-ups, confirmed attendance, and the attendance rate of the teams you coach and their players.

statistics.intro_own.text: Your own numbers, and those of your children.

statistics.times_in.text: Periods follow the group's time zone:

statistics.no_seasons.text: The group has no seasons yet, so there is no season or season part to show. Weeks and months work without one.

statistics.note.text: Only events that have ended and were not cancelled count. For a player, events are those of the teams they are on now, sign-ups are the answers "I'll be there" and nominations, and the rate is attended events over events. For a team, the figures add up its current players over its events. Attendance at another team's events is not counted.
